metadata.title: Enzo Interiors
metadata.description: Bespoke interior design & fitted furniture, designed and handcrafted in Leicester.

mapConsent.note: This map is served by Google, which sets its own cookies when it loads.

newsletter.label: The Studio Letter
newsletter.thanks: Nearly there. Check {email} for a link to confirm.
newsletter.error: That did not go through. Check the address and try again.

cookieBanner.body: We keep one small item on your device to remember this choice. With your permission we also show a Google Map, which sets Google's own cookies. We use no analytics and no advertising — if that ever changes, we will ask first.
cookieBanner.recommendedNote: “Accept recommended” turns on maps and embedded content and leaves analytics off. “Accept all” turns on everything listed here. “Reject all” keeps only what is strictly necessary. You can change your mind at any time from “Cookie settings” at the foot of every page.

rows.title: Strictly necessary
rows.body: Remembers this choice and keeps the enquiry form working. Cannot be switched off.

rows.title: Analytics
rows.body: Not in use today. Turning this on now permits it only if we add it later; leaving it off means we never will for you.

functional.title: Maps and embedded content
functional.body: Shows where we are on a Google Map at the foot of each page. The map is served by Google, which sets its own cookies and receives your IP address when it loads; Google's privacy policy applies. Leave this off and the map stays hidden until you ask for it — the “View on Google Maps” link works either way.

notFound.heading: This room doesn't exist — yet.
notFound.body: The page you're looking for has been moved, deleted, or perhaps never existed. Let us help you find your way back to beautiful spaces.

comingSoon.heading: A new home for Enzo Interiors is nearly ready.
comingSoon.body: We are putting the finishing touches to the new site. In the meantime we are still measuring, drawing and building — get in touch and we will talk about your room.

newsletter.confirmed: You are on the list. The next Studio Letter will come to you.
newsletter.alreadyUnsubscribed: This address has unsubscribed, so this link no longer signs it up. Sign up again any time.
newsletter.unsubscribeBody: You will not get any more newsletters. Nothing else changes.
newsletter.unsubscribed: Done. You will not hear from us again unless you sign up.
newsletter.invalid: That link is not valid any more. If you meant to sign up, try again from the website.
